health.title: Health & Activity Sync
health.status: Manual activity logging remains active. No health connection is enabled in this web app.
health.privacy: Aethora does not request or access health data from this browser.
health.web: Apple Health, Google Health Connect, and Google Fit do not provide a reliable cross-browser API for importing steps into this app.
health.native: The Capacitor app would need platform permissions, an iOS HealthKit bridge, an Android Health Connect bridge, and a secure sync layer before automatic activity import can be added.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Aethora is a fantasy fitness RPG. This policy describes the information used to provide the app.
privacy.section1: When you sign in, Supabase Authentication handles your account. Aethora may store game progress, including level, XP, streaks, quest and workout completion, and related settings in the connected Supabase data store.
privacy.section2: Activity and workout details that you enter are used to calculate game progress and rewards. The current web app does not connect to Apple Health, Google Fit, or Health Connect.
privacy.section3: The app displays advertisements through Monetag where enabled. The ad provider may process information under its own privacy policy, including device or advertising identifiers where permitted.
privacy.section4: We use information to authenticate you, save progress, operate quests and rewards, provide requested features, and maintain app security.
privacy.section5: We do not publish your private account information. Data may be processed by Supabase and Monetag to provide their services, or disclosed when required by law. Retention depends on account and service needs.
privacy.section6: You may stop using the app or request account-data assistance through the app publisher. Device and browser controls may also limit advertising technologies.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Aethora, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
terms.section1: Aethora provides fantasy-themed fitness quests, workouts, progression, streaks, rewards, reminders, and related entertainment features.
terms.section2: Aethora is not medical advice, a medical device, or a substitute for professional care. Choose activities appropriate for you and stop if you feel unwell.
terms.section3: Keep account credentials secure and provide accurate information. Do not abuse, reverse engineer, disrupt, or attempt unauthorized access to the service or its rewards.
terms.section4: Features may change, pause, or become unavailable. Progress can be affected by device, network, authentication, or service failures. We may update these terms as the app evolves.
terms.section5: Advertisements may appear through Monetag. Aethora is not responsible for third-party services or external content. To the extent permitted by law, use the app at your own risk.
